author: g6hydro
quote:
Don't call it continuation of a series if that a different game. To all the critics: had no idea that Your opinions can be bought that easily - you’re a disgrace to all of us daily gamer's.  As GTA i rate is 0/10, as any other game i’d give it a solid 5 (10 for how the game looks and 1 for storytelling and characters). In previous gta we’ve had 3 totally different personalities that had their own unique problems - in this gta we have a much bigger world and no characters that can cover it in an interesting way. Game instead of encouraging You to explore the world that they have spent 13y on building, turns Your focus to a non-rellevant matter such as building up the relation with Lucia. Now before all those Kings who usually play 3hours per week but now they’ve played 12h in 2 days start to go bersersk let me tell You something about the series itself - GTA build their reputation world wide on edgy humor, controversial scenes and a lot, a lot of violance - in GTA6 they have stripped their own game of that core things, and no surprise that many people just felt disappointed. People are rating this game based on looks and on hyped expectations that they had - they lack perspective to think in a way: “what would that game look like if”. Instead they just focus on how it is now and not on what it could’ve been - they refuse to admit that it didn't meet their expectations because they still have couple of days off from doctor to play and they don't want to ruin it for themselves.

To sum it up:

The game is supposed to be a game, not a tutorial on how You should behave in life, not  a platform to force Your ideologies to younger minds. In GTA6 online PC community will eat You alive and they sure as hell will mod the F out of Your game. For online obviously review will be different since it can be saved by community - review above is about campaign only.
